_note: The clip queue. A record is published only when `watched` carries the ISO date a person watched it: sourceUrl proves the video exists, and nothing but watching proves the timestamp, the quote or the frame. `parasocialScore` may be null, and must carry `scoreMethod` when it is not - a number with no stated method is a promise the build cannot keep. `quoteSnippet` may be null, and must carry `quoteSource` when it is not. Add with tools/clips.py --add; validate with --check; see what the front page would show with --resolve.
